label: GO WITH CONDITIONS
recommendation: Operate as a free-to-consumer property and land discovery marketplace. Build reliable public search and current inventory in a bounded Kigali launch market, then monetise qualified partner exposure, professional tools and consent-based introductions.
conditions: Core public search, basic property/parcel discovery and consumer browsing remain free.
Establish a bounded launch market with active, verified and recently updated inventory before scaling paid acquisition.
Start with one or two paying partner groups, likely agents/agencies and developers or rental managers.
Label all paid placement and protect organic search relevance and factual data from payment influence.
Share personal contact details only after explicit, purpose-specific consent.
Measure search-to-contact, lead validity, partner response, conversion, renewal and contribution margin.
Keep development/JV underwriting and cash separate from marketplace operations.
Mortgage, insurance and transaction-linked referrals require written partner agreements and local legal review.
next_steps: Define launch geography, property categories, listing freshness/verification rules and the free user journey.
Interview and onboard a small cohort of agents, landlords and developers. Capture actual search demand and enquiries.
Test one paid partner offer only after measurable qualified enquiries exist; review conversion, renewal intent and contribution.
cheapest_test: Give a small cohort free basic listing and public search access in one Kigali segment, route consented enquiries, then offer partners a clearly priced campaign or qualified-lead pilot.
kill_criteria: Do not scale spend or partner inventory if seekers cannot find current relevant listings, qualified enquiries are too few for partners to renew, or data quality/privacy cannot be maintained.
